feature_policy: All 25790 coordinates, original order and preprocessing; original five RNA datasets and training CITE RNA included. No held-out cell used in representation training.

scgen.adaptation: Tissue/celltype/condition-specific training latent centroid shift; donor-balanced source and target arithmetic; target-specific shift learned only from training populations.

cellot.adaptation: Independent official-architecture ICNN pair for each observable human route and mouse CTRL Mono-to-Micro, evaluated in parallel with numerical equivalence checks.

representation_training.selection: Validation reconstruction MSE averaged over held-out human-brain and CITE donors; fixed seeded cell sample up to 256 per donor; no test access
representation_training.sampling: Uniform over all training cells; all training cells eligible
representation_training.loss: Unchanged official reconstruction objectives on original full-coordinate input matrix

cellot_selection: Validation latent MMD plus 0.1 mean-MSE using training-only frozen scale; route-wise best validation checkpoint. Mouse CTRL Mono-to-Micro uses internal 20 percent unit-balanced training-cell holdout (no external LPS targets), clearly marked internal validation.

evaluation.human: Original locked four test brain donors; all observable routes; identical original seeded source cells and target cells (1024 cap); same assay masks/scales; unchanged frozen world model using corrected prescribed latent-noise inference.
evaluation.lps: Original eight animal inputs, 128 fixed source cells each, 11330 frozen response coordinates, same reciprocal train4/test4 processing folds; alpha1 gene-wise source-only, model-only and source-plus-model ridge fitted separately within training fold. Direct predictions also reported.
primary_metrics: LPS mean animal-level relative MSE reduction
LPS MSE relative to strongest non-world combined baseline
evaluation.aggregation: Human: equal routes within each donor, then equal donors. LPS: equal animals; response genes are not independent replication. No post-test metric or subset selection; all results retained.
evaluation.test_policy: Existing tests are previously examined benchmarks, not new blind validation. No test-based training, hyperparameter or checkpoint selection. No claim of independent peripheral blood collection in GSE245309.
